links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses against patient-facing readability benchmarks
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across interfaces, but none met predefined patient-facing readability benchmarks.
links.quote: Readability differed significantly across interfaces, but none met predefined patient-facing readability benchmarks.

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM answers versus patient-appropriate benchmarks
links.effect: None of the five interfaces met predefined patient-facing readability benchmarks across six readability indices.
links.quote: Readability differed significantly across interfaces, but none met predefined patient-facing readability benchmarks.

links.outcome: Proportion of unsafe or inaccurate LLM responses to IC/BPS questions
links.effect: Unsafe responses occurred in all interfaces, ranging from 5.2% for ChatGPT to 8.6% for DeepSeek and Doubao, with no significant between-interface difference (Cochran Q = 1.000, p = 0.910).
links.quote: Unsafe responses occurred in all interfaces, ranging from 5.2% for ChatGPT to 8.6% for DeepSeek and Doubao, without a significant between-interface difference (Cochran Q = 1.000, p = 0.910).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of 5 commercial LLMs answering patient questions regarding interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome, assessed by urologists for safety, accuracy, empathy, and readability.
